prompts.attack.png: Create a clean production 2D sprite sheet from this exact character reference. EXACTLY SIX poses in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid with equal SQUARE cells. Every pose fully INSIDE its own cell with 12 percent transparent padding on all four sides; no overlap between cells. Transparent background. Same weathered steel plate, full helmet, torn crimson cloak, straight sword, rear three-quarter camera facing right. Same body height and foot baseline within every cell. Read left to right then second row: 1 READY reference stance sword lowered; 2 WINDUP sword raised diagonally behind the RIGHT shoulder, the right arm is on image RIGHT side and holds sword in ALL six poses; left hand empty hanging left; 3 SWING right arm swinging blade forward with small step; 4 CONTACT right arm extended forward right holding sword horizontally; 5 FOLLOW THROUGH right arm and sword lowered diagonally across right front after swing; 6 RETURN to exact reference ready stance. Do not switch sword hands. Each body is separately fully drawn, never clipped, no cross-cell swords, cape ends kept inside cells. Realistic detailed painted dark fantasy game art preserving exact armor identity and proportions. No slash effect, glow, motion trail, shadow, text, labels, boxes or scenery. Build whole sheet at once with consistent scale. This is six frames, not five. Empty left hand must remain empty.
prompts.reactions.png: Production game sprite sheet, same exact Reaver character as reference. Six full body figures in a 3 columns x 2 rows layout, fully transparent background. Camera stays rear three-quarter facing right, weathered full silver plate armor and closed helmet, torn crimson cloak, right hand holds the same straight sword pointed down; left hand empty. Maintain identical model, camera, body scale. Pose sequence row-major: 1 hurt recoil, shoulders flinch back, knees bend slightly, sword stays held; 2 hurt recovery returning to stance; 3 down defeated kneeling forward one knee on ground, head lowered, sword resting against ground held in right hand; 4 power cast wind-up left open palm close to chest, right sword lowered; 5 spell release left arm extends forward right with open empty palm, right sword lowered; 6 casting recovery to ready stance. All six cells equally sized with very generous transparent margins. Keep each full figure, sword and cloak strictly within its cell. No overlapping cells. Fine painted dark fantasy style exactly as supplied. NO glow, magic effects, particles, scenery, contact shadows, labels, borders or text. Important: actual transparent alpha background, not painted brown. Each pose must have exactly two arms and two legs; no duplicate sword.
prompts.casts.png: Production sprite sheet: THREE full body casting poses of EXACT character supplied, one horizontal row in THREE equal SQUARE cells. Preserve weathered steel full plate, helmet, torn crimson cloak, rear three-quarter camera facing right. For ALL poses the straight sword is safely SHEATHED at the left hip, both hands empty, no held sword anywhere. Pose 1: basic power cast, gauntleted hands gather near chest, upright stance. Pose 2: spell cast wind-up, left hand close to chest, right empty hand raised preparing release. Pose 3: spell release, right arm stretched forward right with OPEN EMPTY PALM, left empty hand near chest. Keep full figures and cloak fully inside each cell, large clear transparent padding, matching height and grounded feet. Transparent alpha background. No magic, no aura, no light spill, no effects, no scenery, no shadows, no text, no labels, no borders. Same detailed painted dark fantasy sprite style, exact outfit and proportions.
